rollout.notes: Release tooling and documentation update; runtime source and frontend patch unchanged from 0.4.8. No new configuration or global instruction block. Qualify actual 0.4.8 TUI with 0.4.9 helpers, advisor and holds in both directions, quiet rollback to 0.4.8, packaged recovery/captures and released AP replay. Coordinator protocol 5 and execution record format 1 stay unchanged. No daemon restart; quiet checkpoint with executions and relevant advisor calls drained. Session restart loads the new package; installed and running versions remain separate. Retain 0.4.8 while in use, including foreign workstreams. Publication and rollout retain their action grants.
